steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Don't force yourself. Leave the rest of the monsters to me.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: No way. Your delicate hands are not meant for that, Miss Lisa.
With a few swings of her knives, the last few shadows turn into smoke, but McQueen's face gets a little paler.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Okay, okay, save the caring words. This doesn't suit your character.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: As I said, the mutation of this exhibition may be the punishment of the witch to us greedy Eastsiders. You don't need to deal with them, Miss Lisa.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Besides, we've made a deal. You help me find the exit, and I'll escort you out, right?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: I never agreed to any deal, so don't try to trick me into anything.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Oh, my good lady, keeping my word is the only thing I try not to stop doing. Just let me have this, okay?

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: Tsk, what deal... Getting bullied by weak little monsters like that... I don't trust you to escort me.
Lisa complains but doesn't keep arguing, even taking into account McQueen's condition and slowing down her pace.

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Weak? ...They're really coming for me, it's not time to let Lisa deal with them yet...

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Nothing... Didn't you ask to keep a five-meter distance Miss Lisa? Why are you getting closer?

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: I see, you can't resist my charm after all...

steps.speaker: McQueen
steps.content: Hey... <size=44>Wait! Don't speed up! Miss Lisa!</size>...
